name: Grass Valley
seo_title: Grass Valley Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events, 1 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Grass Valley, California for 2026 including Nevada City: 4 family events, 1 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Grass Valley and Nevada City celebrate with Victorian street faires, carolers and Santa at the fairgrounds.
celebrates: Historic downtown Grass Valley fills Mill and Main Streets with Cornish Christmas on four Friday nights, with handcrafted gifts, carolers and a free shuttle. The Nevada County Fairgrounds hosts the Country Christmas Faire over Thanksgiving weekend with Santa in the Chapel, wagon rides and a community bonfire. Next door, the Nevada City Chamber of Commerce runs Victorian Christmas on five days in December with Santa at the Miners Foundry and strolling Victorian carolers. Empire Mine State Historic Park adds Holidays at Empire Mine on December 5, with Victorian Santa and Mrs. Claus, candle dipping and tin punching.
lastyear: Last year Grass Valley held the 57th Cornish Christmas, since the 2026 celebration is billed as the 58th annual. Nevada City's Victorian Christmas, which the chamber says has run since 1978, also returned in December 2025.
facts: Nevada City's Victorian Christmas has been going since 1978, and kids under 15 ride the shuttle free, as does anyone wearing a Victorian costume. Santa photos are at the Miners Foundry on Spring Street, and Father Christmas strolls the streets on Sundays.
trains: The Nevada County Narrow Gauge Railroad Museum in Nevada City preserves local narrow gauge railroad history, and admission to the museum is free. Check its site for any holiday programs, since none were confirmed for 2026 on the pages we checked.

faq: Fridays November 27 and December 4, 11 and 18, from 6 to 9 pm on Mill and Main Streets in downtown Grass Valley. It is free.
When is Nevada City Victorian Christmas in 2026?
Sundays December 6, 13 and 20 from 1:30 to 6 pm, and Wednesdays December 9 and 16 from 5 to 9 pm.
Where can kids meet Santa in Grass Valley?
Santa is in the Chapel at the Country Christmas Faire on November 27 to 29, and at the Miners Foundry at Nevada City's Victorian Christmas.
How do I park for Cornish Christmas?
A shuttle starts at the Tinloy Street Transit Center with stops at the Fairgrounds Gate 8 and nearby shopping centers. The last shuttle leaves at 8 pm.
Is there a Christmas event at Empire Mine?
Yes. Holidays at Empire Mine is Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 11 am to 4 pm. Entry is $5 per person, and ages 5 and under are free.
